title: New Agentic Browsing Lighthouse Category
summary: PageSpeed Insights has introduced a new 'agentic-browsing' category to its Lighthouse audit results.
details: The schema for Categories now includes an `agentic-browsing` property (type LighthouseCategoryV5). This addition indicates that Lighthouse is beginning to track and group audits specifically related to how autonomous agents or AI-driven browsers interact with web content, expanding the API's scope beyond traditional human-centric performance and accessibility metrics.
